entries.en: to use; to spend, to lay out
entries.notes: R 栏空白；M 栏于「使用」后另缀二音节，H 栏无对应字，未强解。

entries.en: expense, cost, outlay
entries.notes: L 栏加括号承前词头 gastar，为同一词的名物化用例。

entries.zh: 使费，花费（市井俗语）；用钱
entries.en: to spend, to lay out money (colloquial)
entries.notes: H 栏第 3 字有疑（标注 疑：泻/阔），全词仍可读为「使费」加「用」；L 之 vulgar 指市井通行语。

entries.zh: 乱用，胡乱花费，挥霍无度
entries.en: to spend without order, to squander
to waste, to squander to no purpose
entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（标注 疑：屋/虚），取「虚费」空耗之义，与 L 之 sin orden 相合。

entries.en: to consume, to wear away by spending
to waste, to spoil, to damage by misuse
entries.notes: 「打损」为闽南俗语，义近糟蹋、白费，非字面之击打损伤。

entries.en: [text damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L 栏断裂（ganam⁵te…azy~），H 栏首字疑（标注 疑：烟/囡），H 与 M 合成不成可解之词，义无定夺。

entries.zh: 甘食，舍得吃用；引申为用度不吝
entries.en: to spend without stinting, to be open-handed (lit. to eat willingly)
entries.notes: L 栏拼写残损（hontedad…sin miseria），据 H「甘食」与 sin miseria（不吝惜）定为不吝花费之义。

entries.en: to suffice for use, to be enough for one's needs
entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（标注 疑：到/够），据 L「gastar lo necessario」取「够用」。

entries.en: enough to use, sufficient for use
entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（标注 疑：到/够），取「够使」。

entries.en: to spend all of one's money
to spend money to no purpose, to waste money
entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（标注 疑：徒/杜），取「徒费」白白耗散之义。

entries.en: sparing, stinting; to spend scantily
entries.notes: L 栏作 gastar sin provecho，与 H「简略」之省约义不合，此处从 H/M，存疑。

entries.en: to economize, to cut down expenses
entries.notes: 同上条，L 栏作 gastar sin provecho，与省约义不合，从 H/M 并存疑。

entries.zh: 奢侈，用度豪奢（尤指治装）
entries.en: extravagant, lavish (especially in dress)
entries.notes: M 栏第 2 音节音标污损（T99），H 栏「奢侈」清楚，义不受影响。

entries.en: luxurious, sumptuous
a great spendthrift, one who breaks his money; to lose money
to encroach upon and spend, to embezzle and spend (uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（标注 疑：侵/浸），M 所对之词非常用，义近侵用、挪用耗费，未能定夺。

entries.en: to spend money, to go to expense
a spendthrift; a loafer, idler (holgazán)
entries.notes: H 栏首字有疑（标注 疑：丰/风）；L 之 holgacan 疑即 holgazán（游手好闲者），与「丰费」并列。

entries.en: to be eaten away, to dwindle (of an estate or fortune)
